notes: Completeness checked 2026-10-02: /votacao returned the same codigoSessaoVotacao set as the deprecated /plenario/lista/votacao (monthly, 2019 and 2024) and the static /dados/ListaVotacoes{ano}.json (every year 2019-2026). Clerk results /plenario/resultado/mes (independent Ordem do Dia system) matched 2024-07 (14/14), 2024-12 (35/35) and 2025-09 (8/8, same Sim/Não tallies); it has no data for 2019.

Low yearly counts are mostly real: the Senado decides most matters by symbolic vote. But the panel feed (orientations.unlinked_panel_votes, reason no_stored_vote) lists a few Senado nominal votes that /votacao does not publish (2019-02-12 requerimento de retirada de pauta, 2019-04-10 Requerimento 80/2019 verificação, 2022-04-06 Mensagem 86/2021). They are not stored: the panel feed has no senator codes, only names.
sve_sequence.numbers_not_in_api is not a missing-vote count: in 2019 sequencialVotacao is neither chronological nor contiguous; from 2022 on it is nearly contiguous.

p_nrv_entries: P-NRV is stored as present_not_voted, but the official vote page shows NCom for 182 of 1,843 P-NRV entries checked (160 votes; worst 2020 remote sessions, 58/116). Display it as 'não registrou voto', never as 'presente'.

votes_listing_only_voters: the cast list names only who voted (no absence codes), so a senator missing from it is 'desconhecido', not 'ausente'. votes_with_more_than_81: both a senator and his substitute are listed (5999: Eduardo Gomes NCom, Siqueira Campos Votou).
party_abbr is the senator's party at vote time under the name /votacao publishes now: renamed parties show the current sigla (April 2019 votes already say PL, not PR).
